summary: The completed ruled majority/one-sheet interval domination cannot be upgraded to continuity of that submeasure. For A=diag(1,1,-1) and iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], the full output density is continuous with p_Q(0)=pi, but the majority submeasure 1_{Q>=0} law has density p_Q(t)1_{t>=0} a.e. and no continuous representative. This is not a QFORM counterexample; the full output remains continuous and bounded. Preserve componentwise height and full-output continuity as separate claims.
